names: First Peoples’ Heritage, Language and Culture Council

purpose: Preserves the audit of the original three-collection snapshot before official-source replacements and annual backfills. These are baseline findings, not the current generated totals.
cautions: Exact duplicate row counts are flags for source review, not proof that every repeated row is erroneous. Anonymous rows must not be deduplicated solely because pay and position agree.
Collection labels do not establish exact employer reporting periods. Missing employer-years include true gaps, source exclusions, organization renames and scope changes.
Large executive compensation values are not automatically data errors. The five BCI 2023/24 rows do not establish employee-wide coverage.
The original snapshot contains 5,750 named rows without a comma. Some are surname-first, some given-first, and some rank placeholders; a global name-order heuristic would be unsafe.
The original name key retained only surname and first given name; 923 employer/year groups contain distinct raw names under that key. They are collision flags, not verified distinct identities.
